import bpy,json
from pathlib import Path
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent
cap=root/'captures/shipyard_painterly_20261112'
exp=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Export']
# Keep stable image names so Godot retains compression settings and UIDs.
images={n.image for o in exp.objects for s in o.material_slots if s.material for n in s.material.node_tree.nodes if n.type=='TEX_IMAGE' and n.image}
for im in images:
 name=Path(bpy.path.abspath(im.filepath)).stem
 if '_V2_' not in name:continue
 other=bpy.data.images.get(name)
 if other and other!=im:
  assert other.users==0, 'Unexpected shared texture collision'
  other.name=name+'_previous'
 im.name=name
hidden=(exp.hide_viewport,exp.hide_render)
exp.hide_viewport=False;exp.hide_render=False
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='DESELECT')
for ob in exp.objects:ob.hide_set(False);ob.select_set(True)
bpy.context.view_layer.objects.active=next(iter(exp.objects))
(cap/'export_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'stage':'painterly_final','status':'exporting'}),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.export_scene.gltf(filepath=str(root/'assets/coast/shipyard_combined.glb'),export_format='GLB',use_selection=True,export_apply=True,export_yup=True,export_cameras=False,export_lights=False)
exp.hide_viewport,exp.hide_render=hidden
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
(cap/'export_progress.json').write_text(json.dumps({'stage':'painterly_final','status':'complete','meshes':len(exp.objects)}),encoding='utf8')
print('PAINTERLY_FINAL_EXPORT_COMPLETE')
